observations: Photo 0: A white and black wall-mounted hair dryer with a black hood, mounted on a wall with a black bracket. The unit has a control panel with two dials and a red indicator light. The brand 'MANGO' is visible on a sticker on the front.
Photo 1: Same unit from a slightly different angle, showing the control panel more clearly. The brand 'MANGO' is again visible on the sticker. The unit appears to be in a salon setting.

Photo 2: A wider shot showing the full unit mounted on the wall. The black hood is attached to a vertical pole, and the unit is connected to a power cord. The wall is plain white, and a shelf is visible above.

Photo 3: A full view of the unit mounted on the wall, with a mirror and a container of brushes visible to the left. The unit appears to be in good condition with no visible damage. The power cord is plugged into a wall socket.

claims.claim: Mango wall hair dryer for salons.
claims.evidence: The brand 'MANGO' is visible on the sticker in all photos, and the unit is mounted on a wall with salon-like surroundings (mirror, brushes, shelf).

claims.claim: 6 months of use and in a very perfect condition.
claims.evidence: The unit appears clean and undamaged in all photos, but there is no visual proof of usage duration or internal condition. The 'perfect condition' claim cannot be verified remotely.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The unit may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit turning on, the fan spinning, and the heating element working, or a close-up of the internal components.

risks.risk: The power cord or plug may be damaged or incompatible with Nigerian outlets.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the power cord and plug, showing no fraying or damage, and confirming it is a standard 3-pin plug for Nigeria.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional or incompatible

risks.risk: The unit may have been used in a salon environment and may have hidden wear or residue.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the interior of the hood and the base, showing no residue, stains, or damage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly used with residue or damage

proof_requests: Close-up of the rating plate on the iron to confirm the model and capacity.
Video of the unit turning on and operating, showing fan and heating function.
Close-up photo of the power cord and plug, showing no damage.
Close-up photo of the interior of the hood and base, showing no residue or damage.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
